title: Comment on “Does preoperative joint space affect accuracy in splint-based Le Fort I osteotomy?”
html: We read with interest the article by Han et al., “Does preoperative joint space affect accuracy in splint-based Le Fort I osteotomy?”1. The authors address an underexplored question, and their use of regional voxel-based registration to quantify surgical error is commendable. We would like to offer a perspective that bears directly on the interpretation of their findings.
